_note: Held-out round 4 for bid-parse / bid-tech / bid-compliance. Written 2026-09-21 with the rules frozen at commit 79d54d5 and before any case was run; the exactly-once check is part of the generator. It measures what that day's first batch added and no round had: a tender written in English (Singapore), Chinese chat with English terms, a project named without a label, BCA workhead registration, anybody named with a post beside the project manager, compound surnames, English personal names, lots written A标段 / B标段. Field patterns for the two new kinds of fact follow the dev set's pattern for the nearest kind.
